purpose: Convert each medical MCQ into a consistent six-scene bilingual teaching video.

characters.function: proposes the answer and explains the clinical thought process
corrects, explains, exposes traps, and gives the memory anchor

scenes.name: QUESTION
scenes.objective: Present the complete source question without changing its meaning.
scenes.visual: question card with clinical clue emphasis

scenes.name: ANSWER_PROPOSAL
scenes.objective: Let Dr. Anas propose the source-indicated answer before the teacher confirms it.

scenes.name: CLINICAL_REASONING
scenes.objective: Teach why the correct answer is correct using source-grounded reasoning.

scenes.name: DISTRACTORS
scenes.objective: Explain why the competing options are wrong and identify the decisive distinction.

scenes.name: EXAM_TRAP
scenes.objective: Expose the common exam trap and state the trigger that prevents the mistake.

scenes.name: TAKE_HOME
scenes.objective: Finish with the trigger, memory anchor, and final answer.

fidelityRules: Never silently change the wording of the source question.
Keep the original option letters and option text.
Separate source facts from teaching commentary.
If teaching data is missing, show an explicit fallback instead of fabricating medical content.
